why: Password reset links: one document per link under the GUID the link carries, holding the signed token that names the account, the site and the password's fingerprint. The container's time-to-live is the hour a link lives, so an expired link names nothing without anything having to run; the document is deleted when the link is used, which is what makes it one use. Read and deleted by id only, never queried, so nothing is indexed (ADR: Accounts and per-user bids, addendum of 14 September).
